records.name: DNS - Set to:
records.refresh: Restart Windows to activate adapter DNS settings.
records.sourceAvailability: No general OS build/edition gate is declared for this control. Evaluate native applicability independently.
notes: Upstream DNS helper has no automatic partial rollback. DHCP reset is not previous-state restoration.

Source invokes Set-DnsClientServerAddress first with IPv4 list and then IPv6 list using the same InterfaceIndex and no AddressFamily selector; verify resulting dual-stack behavior rather than assuming both lists persist.

Roo Industries binds active default-route interfaces and stages their DNS registry configuration for restart. Global encrypted-DNS registration uses Windows DNS Client APIs. Restore replays original values and provider records; DHCP is a separate choice and does not delete shared DoH registrations.
Mullvad announced its public DNS service ends on2026-11-02; do not select these providers after that date.
requirements: Resolve stable interface GUID/index/name and capture IPv4/IPv6 DNS and DHCP states; review VPN/Tailscale interfaces rather than selecting every Up adapter blindly.
Add-DnsClientDohServerAddress availability is mandatory for DohOnly providers.

sharedContracts.ordering: Optional restore point first, selected DNS second, then other selected controls. Within a control: declarative services, declarative registry, script.
sharedContracts.toggle: Checked invokes apply; unchecked invokes vendor undo. Missing values may be treated according to configured DefaultState.
sharedContracts.mpo: Registry-backed choice with before-state capture and verified rollback on partial failure, but rollback uses configured registry kind rather than captured original kind.
sharedContracts.serviceDefaults: KeepServiceStartup=true skips declarative service apply when existing startup differs from configured OriginalType. Direct Set-Service calls in scripts do not use this guard.
sharedContracts.registryView: The PowerShell registry provider follows the running process view; helper has no explicit32/64 view binding.
sharedContracts.nativeImplementation: Normalize duplicate atomic resources across source tools; keep destructive cleanup/uninstall and network/power operations explicit. Never run opaque upstream scripts as a substitute for owned native implementation.
